description: Wave 8 part C: single-event step-level dissection of the top gap dipole and top absorber |W| spike (unsevered -x0 -y0 -B0, shared RNG stream). Env-gated step telemetry (HEPEMSHOW_STEP_DUMP + HEPEMSHOW_DUMP_EVENT) added on worktree branch knob/step-telemetry (from knob/race-score 7ebab9e); byte-identity gate passed (n=2000 edeps_1/edeps_gap_1/dump.txt identical to the 7ebab9e reference run when env unset).
replay_verification: both replayed events' per-event dump rows (50 primal edeps + 50 dots + signature) byte-identical to part-A wave8_runs rows

gap_event.energy_conservation_check: sum of track 10489 per-layer edep dots = +0.2003 = birth ekin_dot exactly (relative residual ~1e-9); the dipole is pure bin relabeling of a fixed energy
gap_event.single_track_dominance: of 12111 tracks in the event, only 17 ever exceed |edep_dot|>2e3 and only the carrier exceeds 1e5 (next largest 9.7e4)

top5_steps_by_edep_dot.mechanism: range-out full-deposit branch dumps the accumulated ekin_dot (ElectronManager ApplyMeanEnergyLoss full-deposit)
boundary-limited crossing: eloss = dEdx x stepLen, stepLen_dot = (plane_dot - preX_dot)/vx = -2.25e8 (S2 numerator; vx=0.82, NOT grazing)
energy-loss fluctuation sampling dots proportional to ekin_dot (recycles Ekin_dot up before range-out)

absorber_event.energy_conservation_check: sum of track 3291 per-layer edep dots = -2042 = birth ekin_dot exactly
absorber_event.mechanism: SAME loop as the gap event (audit's 'expect S1 for absorber' prediction falsified). Multi-generation seeding: e+ 3262 (born x_dot 0.0245, healthy) ran ~1.5 cycles of the same loop at the same L18|L19 interface (x_dot to 2.2e4); its brems gamma 3285 was born with x_dot 4.3e3 and direction dot ~ -2.6e4 inherited through emission kinematics; after a 5 mm flight the secondary e- 3291 was born with x_dot -1.24e5; two crossings (steps 2 and 12) multiplied ekin_dot to 2.5e5 then 3.87e6; range-out at step 31 deposited +4.1e6 in L19-abs

mechanism.name: boundary-relabeling dipole loop: S2-numerator x energy-conservation x MSC re-injection (S4 compounding with THREE state carriers)
loop: 1. S2 numerator (Box.cc DistanceToOut t=(copysign(hD,v)-p)/v via Geometry::CalculateDistanceToOut): at a boundary-limited crossing, stepLen_dot = (plane_dot - x_dot)/vx. The amplitude is the ACCUMULATED position dot in the numerator, not 1/vx: measured crossing vx = 0.23-0.90, never below the 0.2 grazing class; 1/vx contributed <= 5x total while the numerator carried up to 1.8e8

2. energy transfer (ElectronManager ApplyMeanEnergyLoss, eloss = pStepLength*dEdx): the crossing's eloss_dot = dEdx x stepLen_dot is scored in the CURRENT bin (one pole) and, by Ekin -= eloss, flips sign into ekin_dot (the carrier of the other pole)

3. MSC re-injection (UMSC SampleCosineTheta / RotateToReferenceFrame / SampleDisplacement, S5/S6/S7 class): angle Jacobians convert pStepLength_dot and ekin_dot into direction dots (measured vx_dot: 0.9 -> 3.0e4 in ONE scattering at gap step 0, gain ~63 per unit pSL_dot; up to 1.3e10 late); each subsequent step rebuilds the position dot via x_dot += stepLen*vx_dot (~1.7e7/step measured, ~80% of growth) plus displacement dots (~20%), all proportional to ekin_dot

4. scoring (SteppingAction, discrete (indxLayer, indxAbsorber) bins): the crossing pole lands in the pre-step bin; the compensating pole lands at range-out (full-deposit branch dumps the whole accumulated ekin_dot into the last bin). Sum over the track = birth ekin_dot (small): pure relabeling
mechanism.per_cycle_gain: x12 -> x226 -> x557 (gap event); gain ~ n_steps x (MSC coefficient ~50 mm/MeV) x dEdx / vx, grows as EKin falls (30-250 keV electrons)
mechanism.S1_verdict: the electron mfp x numIA product NEVER set the step limit on any amplifier step in either event (all winner=-2 continuous/MSC-limited; numIA dots grew to 4.9e5 but never landed in a stepLen). Gamma-side S8 injections were seed-scale only (<= ~1e4 with -C 1000 active).
mechanism.grazing_verdict: no grazing needed: the top spikes are numerator-driven; -f/-y/-B target the wrong variable (and partial severing creates the worse zombie population, per part A)

proposal_1_el_mfp_cap.reason: no amplifier step was mfp*numIA-limited; the binding carrier is position/direction/energy dots, not the electron discrete-channel step limit

proposal_2_track_dot_cap.gap_event: x_dot first exceeds 250 at step 14 (335); clamped, worst crossing stepLen_dot <= (250+33)/0.225 ~ 1.3e3, pole <= ~2e3 MeV/mm vs 2.1e8 (5 orders down)
proposal_2_track_dot_cap.abs_event: birth x_dot -1.24e5 clamped to 250 immediately; pole <= ~2.3e2 vs 3.7e6
proposal_2_track_dot_cap.residual_caveat: as spec'd it caps position+numIA only; ekin_dot and direction dots stay uncapped. In both events they are fed exclusively through the (now clamped) crossing stepLen_dot, so the loop is broken anyway; adding cap_ekin ~ 1e2 MeV/seed would close the carrier explicitly

proposal_3_boundary_dot_cap.gap_event: crossing sL_dot -2.25e8 -> -40; pole <= (edep/sL ratio 1.58) x 40 ~ 63 MeV/mm (below the ~200 physical scale); ekin_dot jump per crossing <= dEdx x 40, so the loop gain collapses
proposal_3_boundary_dot_cap.abs_event: crossing sL_dot -2.18e7 -> -40; pole ~ 2e1; range-out residual bounded by sum of capped crossing elosses
proposal_3_boundary_dot_cap.residual: leaves gamma S8 seed injections (~1e4) and inherited direction dots uncapped; position dots can still reach ~1e4-1e5 transiently but cannot compound without the crossing multiplier, and the scored poles are directly capped
proposal_3_boundary_dot_cap.preferred: caps the net Box distance dot (no cancellation-pair breakage) and directly targets the measured generator; per part A the dipoles cancel to <=1.4e-2 relative in the 50-layer sum, so the total-detector derivative is provably untouched

cap_counterfactuals.verdict: proposal 3 at 40 mm/seed (or proposal 2 at 250 mm/seed) individually neutralizes BOTH dissected events; proposal 1 does not. Recommend proposal 3 first for the wave-9 knob, optionally + an ekin-dot cap as the belt-and-braces second carrier guard.
